image_spec: Clean rink diagram. Gold team attacks right to left. Gold puck carrier is on the right wing. A gold teammate is driving the center lane. The white defender is positioned between the puck carrier and the center-lane teammate, clearly blocking the pass while leaving a clear shooting lane to the white goalie and net.
sit: You are the gold puck carrier on this odd-man rush. The white defender has taken away the pass to your teammate in the middle. What is your best option?
opts: Shoot the puck using the clear lane the defender gave you
Try to force a pass through the white defender to the middle teammate
Stop and wait for the white defender to move away
Carry toward the corner even though the shooting lane is open
explain: When the defender takes away the pass on an odd-man rush, the shot lane is open. Take the ice they give you and put the puck on net.
overlay_intent: Gold arrow from the puck carrier to the net; dim the blocked passing lane and the middle gold teammate.

media.alt: Gold puck carrier on a two-on-one with the white defender taking away the pass and the shot lane open.

image_spec: Clean top-down rink diagram. Gold attacks bottom to top. Gold puck carrier is near the left boards inside the blue line. A gold center drives to the net and pulls one white defender low. Another white defender steps toward the puck carrier. A trailing gold forward is open high in the slot.
sit: You are the gold puck carrier entering the zone. The white defenders are reacting to you and the gold teammate driving the net. Where is the best open space?
opts: The trailing gold forward open in the high slot
The gold center driving into tight coverage near the net
The narrow lane between the white defender and the boards
The far corner away from the scoring area
explain: The middle drive pulls coverage low, and pressure steps toward the puck carrier. That opens the high slot for the trailing gold forward.
overlay_intent: Gold arrow from puck carrier to the trailing high forward; green ring on the trailing forward; dim the covered center drive.

media.alt: Gold zone entry with the net drive pulling coverage low and a trailing gold forward open in the high slot.

image_spec: Clean rink diagram. Gold attacks left to right. Gold puck carrier enters on the right-side lane with the puck. A gold teammate is available on the opposite side. The white defender is backed deep into the slot, leaving a large cushion of open ice in front of the puck carrier.
sit: You are the gold puck carrier on an odd-man rush. The white defender is backing in and giving you a lot of open ice. What should you do first?
opts: Carry the puck into the open space to force the defender to make a choice
Shoot from far away before using the open ice
Throw a blind pass across before the defender commits
Turn toward the boards and shield the puck
explain: If the defender gives you space, use it. Carrying forward improves your shot and can force the defender to open a pass later.
overlay_intent: Gold arrow showing the puck carrier moving into the open ice; dim the immediate cross-ice pass.

media.alt: Gold puck carrier on an odd-man rush with the white defender backed in and open ice ahead.

image_spec: Clean top-down rink diagram. Gold attacks bottom to top. Gold puck carrier is in the middle of the ice. The white defender shades toward the gold teammate on the left side. The gold teammate on the right side is open with a clear lane toward the net.
sit: You have the puck in the middle on an odd-man rush. The white defender shifts toward your gold teammate on the left. Who has the best open ice?
opts: The gold teammate open on the right side
The gold teammate covered on the left side
The small space directly behind the white defender
The corner behind the white goalie
explain: The white defender cannot cover both sides. When they shade toward the left-side teammate, move the puck to the open gold teammate on the right.
overlay_intent: Gold arrow from the puck carrier to the open right-side teammate; green ring on the right-side teammate; dim the left-side teammate and the defender.

media.alt: Gold puck carrier in the middle with the white defender shading left and the right-side gold teammate open.
